info.title: Post-Upload API
info.description:
One API call to publish videos, photos, text and documents to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Discord, Telegram, Slack, Mastodon and WordPress.

**Auth:** `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` (also accepted: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`). Create keys in the dashboard (Dashboard → API Keys). Endpoints marked with SessionCookie only work from the logged-in dashboard; API keys get 401 there.
**HTTPS only:** plain http:// API calls get 426 HTTPS_REQUIRED (never redirected).
**Rate limits:** 300 requests/min per IP across the API, 30 uploads/min, 10 FFmpeg jobs/min. 429 responses carry `Retry-After` and `RateLimit-*` headers.
**Size:** request bodies up to 100 MB; pass `video_url` for larger videos (server downloads up to 500 MB).
**Timeouts:** requests are cut at 100 s at the edge. Uploads are async by default — poll GET /api/upload/{upload_id}/status or use webhooks.
**Errors:** JSON `{ success: false, error, error_code, …details }` (a few older routes omit `success` or use `code`). Branch on HTTP status + `error_code`.

Docs: https://docs.post-upload.com

post.description:
Publish a video to one or more platforms. Request bodies are limited to 100 MB at the edge. For larger videos pass a public `video_url`; the server downloads it (up to 500 MB). Per-platform maxima apply (413 FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PLATFORM).

Platform-specific options are plain form fields (see the platform guides). Missing required fields → 400 MISSING_PLATFORM_FIELD; invalid values → 400 INVALID_PLATFORM_OPTION; unknown `<platform>_…` keys → 400 UNKNOWN_PLATFORM_OPTION.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key: a repeat returns the original upload.

user.description: Profile name the post is published from.

platform[].description: Target platforms (repeat the field). `platform` / `platforms` are accepted too.

first_comment.description: Comment posted right after publishing. Per-platform overrides: `<platform>_first_comment`.

schedule.description: ISO-8601 publish time (alias `schedule_at`). Requires a paid plan.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a schedule without an offset.

add_to_queue.description: Publish at the next free queue slot (409 NO_QUEUE_SLOT when none is free).

async_upload.description: true (default): respond immediately, publish in the background. false: wait up to ~50 s for the per-platform result, then answer like an async upload.

request_id.description: Your own tracking id, echoed back and usable with /api/uploadposts/status.

video.description: Video file (≤100 MB through the API edge). Or a public URL string.

video_url.description: Public video URL the server downloads (up to 500 MB).

privacy_level.description: TikTok — REQUIRED when posting to TikTok, no default. Must be one of the `privacy_level_options` from GET /api/profiles/{name}/tiktok/creator-info (unaudited apps: SELF_ONLY only). Alias `tiktok_privacy`.

instagram_thumb_offset.description: Instagram Reel cover frame offset in ms (alias `thumb_offset`).

post.description: Returns an authorization URL to connect one of YOUR accounts. To let an end user connect THEIR account, use a whitelabel link (POST /api/whitelabel/generate-jwt). Credential platforms use /connect/{platform}/credentials; Bluesky uses /connect/bluesky/app-password.

post.summary: Connect Bluesky with an app password

app_password.description: A Bluesky App Password (Settings → App Passwords), not the account password.

post.summary: Connect a credential platform (Discord, Telegram, Slack, Mastodon, WordPress)

get.summary: TikTok creator info (allowed privacy levels, limits)
get.description: Call before posting to TikTok: `privacy_level` must be one of the returned `privacy_level_options`.

get.summary: Recent media from a connected platform
Live platform analytics for a profile

get.description: The signing secret is never returned here — only `has_webhook_secret`.

post.description: Advanced plan or higher. The response includes `webhook_secret` (created on first configuration and kept on later updates).
Returns the new secret once. Every delivery from now on (including retries of earlier events) is signed with it.

post.summary: Create a branded connect link for an end user
post.description: Professional plan or higher. Links are signed, expire and can be revoked; `platforms` limits what the end user can connect. Supports OAuth platforms only (instagram, youtube, facebook, tiktok, x, linkedin, threads, pinterest, reddit, google_business) — not Bluesky or credential platforms.
Synchronous — keep to short clips: requests are cut at 100 s at the edge. Use POST /api/ffmpeg/jobs/upload for long operations.
Multipart (`file`, `file1`, `file2`) or JSON (`full_command`, `output_extension`, `files[]` URLs). Poll GET /api/ffmpeg/jobs/{jobId}.

get.description: API keys cannot list or create API keys. Alias: /api/api-keys.

post.summary: Create an API key (dashboard session only)

delete.summary: Revoke an API key (dashboard session only)

post.summary: Invite a team member (dashboard session only)

get.description: System health only (database, Redis queue, worker backlog, scheduler lag, pipeline errors, per-platform API outage-class errors). Customer-side post failures do not count. Cached ~30 s.
Active webhook subscriptions of the account. Secrets are never returned.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Only subscriptions for this exact URL

post.description: Adds a webhook endpoint next to the account webhook (several per account, up to 25), each with its own signing secret and an event/profile filter. The secret is returned once, in this response. Deliveries are signed with `X-Post-Upload-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the secret>` and carry `X-Post-Upload-Subscription` and `X-Post-Upload-Event`. Requires the Advanced plan or higher.

profile.description: Profile name; omit for every profile

delete.description: Also stops pending retries for it.

post.summary: Send a test event to a subscription

BearerApiKey.description: Your API key as a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY` (API keys only — not a JWT).

XApiKey.name: x-api-key
XApiKey.description: Your API key in the x-api-key header.

SessionCookie.name: irf_sid
SessionCookie.description: Dashboard login session (HTTP-only cookie set by the web app). Not usable by API clients.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request — e.g. MISSING_VIDEO, MISSING_PLATFORM_FIELD, INVALID_PLATFORM_OPTION, UNKNOWN_PLATFORM_OPTION, X_CAPTION_TOO_LONG, PLATFORM_NOT_CONNECTED, VIDEO_URL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED, INVALID_FILE_CONTENT.

example.error: TikTok needs privacy_level — who can view the post, one of the privacy_level_options from GET /api/profiles/:name/tiktok/creator-info (not defaulted).

PaymentRequired.description: X (Twitter) allowance used up — X_ADDON_REQUIRED (free post used) or X_MONTHLY_LIMIT_REACHED; includes `upgrade_url`.

Forbidden.description: Plan / permission — TIKTOK_PLAN_REQUIRED, UPLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED, SCHEDULING_NOT_AVAILABLE, PROFILE_LOCKED, team role too low.

Conflict.description: Conflict — e.g. NO_QUEUE_SLOT (add_to_queue with no free slot).

PayloadTooLarge.description: FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PLATFORM (`platforms_exceeded[]`) or PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (over 100 MB at the edge — use video_url).

TooManyRequests.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (300/min), UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT (30/min), FFMPEG_RATE_LIMIT, or PLATFORM_RATE_LIMIT (`exceeded[]`; YouTube includes `resets_at`). Honour `Retry-After`.

BadGateway.description: B2_UPLOAD_FAILED (object storage) or the platform/test endpoint failed. Safe to retry.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Temporarily unavailable (maintenance or dependency down). Retry after `Retry-After`.

PlatformState.description: `deferred`: YouTube daily quota reached — the YouTube part moved to a child upload (its `parent_upload_id` is this upload) scheduled after the quota reset.

error_message.description: Raw stored error (a JSON string for failed publishes). Kept for compatibility; prefer `error` and `platform_errors`.

error.description: Human-readable error message, e.g. "All 1 platform(s) failed. First error: …".

platform_errors.description: Per-platform failure details, parsed from error_message.

WebhookEvent.description: POSTed to your webhook_url. Header `X-Post-Upload-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, keyed with your webhook secret>`.

profile.description: Only events for this profile; null = every profile
